mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion and hypotension which may be potentiated by nifedipine's vasodilatory effects, increasing risk of syncope and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum electrolytes (particularly potassium and magnesium), and cardiac function; adjust diuretic dosing if needed and counsel patients on orthostatic hypotension precautions.
